schedule: every 5 minutes, offset from the USDJPY price monitor
source_discovery: Google News RSS in English and Japanese via direct/proxy race

source_tiers.2: two or more independent major-media groups within 6 hours
source_tiers.1: single major-media or identified Kyodo/Reuters syndication

single_source_policy: Only high-materiality intervention, US participation, intervention-preparation, or timed BOJ-hike stories can alert on a single major source. Generic single-source BOJ hike speculation is suppressed.
topics: US-Japan coordinated intervention or US participation
BOJ timed or September hike signal
BOJ hike timing linked to US policy or intervention
verification_upgrade: A previously alerted unconfirmed story can re-alert when corroboration rises to multiple major media or official confirmation.
dedupe: 24-hour topic cooldown unless verification rank or materiality rises
disclaimer: single-source reports are always labeled unconfirmed and never presented as established fact
